text: Lesson 1 introduced the five DP-300 domains and their real weighting. This lesson reviews what each domain drew on across the whole course, then puts you through a real, mixed-domain practice assessment.
Platform resources, security, monitoring and performance, automation, and HA/DR — each domain pulled from multiple chapters, grouped by skill, not by this course's chapter boundaries.
Name the constraint before the options — an RTO, RPO, or compliance requirement rules choices in or out before you even read them. Eliminate the obviously platform-wrong option first.
Eight scenario-based questions spanning deployment choice, purchasing models, query regressions, tamper-evidence, failover groups, DMVs, job troubleshooting, and data masking.
One course, five domains, reviewed. Lesson 95 — this course's genuine final lesson — is next: real DBA interview practice.
